lines.t: Verse 1
Morning breaks and I can feel Your mercy
Like a gentle wind across my face
Every burden that was pressing on me
Starts to fade in the light of Your grace
When the night was long and my heart was weary
You were near, though I could not see
Now I wake to the sound of Your faithfulness
Calling me back to peace
Pre-Chorus
You are my shelter,
You are my song
You hold me steady
When the road feels long
Chorus
Walking in Your light, covered by Your love
Held through the darkness by the One above
When my soul feels weak, You give me strength to stand
Safe in Your promise, held within Your hand
YahuShua, my Savior, my heart’s true song
In Your holy presence, I know I belong
I’m not alone, You lead me home
Verse 2
Like the dawn that paints the sky in wonder
Like the rain that wakes a thirsty ground
Your love keeps growing deeper than I knew before
And it reaches me when I am down
Every step I take, You go before me
Every tear is seen by You alone
Even in the hidden place of silence
You are building something strong
Pre-Chorus
You are my shelter,
You are my song
You hold me steady
When the road feels long
Chorus
Walking in Your light, covered by Your love
Held through the darkness by the One above
When my soul feels weak, You give me strength to stand
Safe in Your promise, held within Your hand
YahuShua, my Savior, my heart’s true song
In Your holy presence, I know I belong
I’m not alone, You lead me home
Verse 3
When the trials come and shadows gather
Still I will not bow to fear
For Your voice is stronger than the thunder
And Your mercy always draws me near
If I stumble, You will lift me gently
If I wander, You will call my name
Nothing in this world can separate me
From the power of Your flame
Bridge
You are the hope that never fades
The Living Word, the endless grace
The One who finds me in the dust
And teaches my heart to trust
You are the King above it all
The Rock that never bends or falls
In joy or sorrow, rise or rain
YahuShua, You remain
Final Chorus
Walking in Your light, covered by Your love
Held through the darkness by the One above
When my soul feels weak, You give me strength to stand
Safe in Your promise, held within Your hand
YahuShua, my Savior, my heart’s true song
In Your holy presence, I know I belong
I’m not alone, You lead me home
Outro
You lead me home
You lead me home
YahuShua, You lead me home
